2608.11732.title: Fingerprinting Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Collapsed Generation
2608.11732.paper_summary: Proprietary text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distributed as hosted services and downloadable checkpoints, making their intellectual property (IP) protection an increasingly critical concern when model leakage, copying, or unauthorized fine-tuning is disputed. In this work, we present a non-invasive model fingerprinting framework based on \emph{collapsed generation}, a phenomenon where certain input conditions produce highly consistent images across multiple stochastic seeds. We show that collapsed generation is an intrinsic, model-dependent property of the learned generation process. These collapse-prone conditions therefore expose model-specific behavioral signatures, enabling reliable ownership verification without embedding invasive watermarks. After preparing conditions on the source model, the framework verifies a suspect model under two access settings: (1) white-box pipeline access, where optimized continuous embeddings can be injected into the generation process, and (2) black-box API-only access, where natural language prompts are queried through the service interface. In both cases, ownership evidence is measured by whether the suspect model reproduces the source model's collapse behavior across stochastic samplings. Extensive experiments across UNet- and transformer-based diffusion models show that collapsed generation fingerprints can distinguish different source models with low confusion. These fingerprints remain verifiable in fine-tuned derivatives and under common and adaptive model- or query-level obfuscations, while requiring only a modest verification query budget. Together, these results establish collapsed generation as a reliable intrinsic evidence source for non-invasive diffusion model ownership verification.
2608.11732.paper_summary_zh: 專有的文本到圖像擴散模型越來越多地作為託管服務和可下載的檢查點進行分發，這使得它們的知識產權（IP）保護在模型洩漏、複製或未經授權的微調爭議中變得越來越重要。在這項工作中，我們提出了一個基於\emph{崩潰生成}的非侵入性模型指紋框架，這是一種現象，在某些輸入條件下，會在多個隨機種子中產生高度一致的圖像。我們展示了崩潰生成是學習生成過程的一個內在、依賴於模型的特性。因此，這些易崩潰的條件暴露了模型特定的行為特徵，使得在不嵌入侵入性水印的情況下能夠可靠地驗證所有權。在準備好源模型的條件後，該框架在兩種訪問設置下驗證可疑模型：（1）白盒管道訪問，優化的連續嵌入可以被注入到生成過程中，以及（2）黑盒僅API訪問，自然語言提示通過服務介面進行查詢。在這兩種情況下，所有權證據是通過可疑模型是否在隨機抽樣中重現源模型的崩潰行為來衡量的。在基於UNet和Transformer的擴散模型中進行的廣泛實驗顯示，崩潰生成指紋可以以較低的混淆度區分不同的源模型。這些指紋在微調的衍生模型中以及在常見和自適應的模型或查詢級別的模糊處理下仍然可驗證，同時僅需適度的驗證查詢預算。綜合這些結果，建立了崩潰生成作為非侵入性擴散模型所有權驗證的可靠內在證據來源。
